errors.meaning: A batch stopped during execution; data.items says which items ran
errors.fix: Fix the failed item (data.items[].error) and send it and the skipped items again

errors.meaning: A group or the bare tool was run without a command
errors.fix: Pick one of `expected`; canon schema --json lists every command

errors.meaning: No canon.yaml in the working directory or any ancestor, or in --repo
errors.fix: Run canon init in the repository root, or pass --repo <DIR>

errors.meaning: canon.yaml exists but cannot be read or parsed
errors.fix: Fix the file named in the message

errors.meaning: The --cursor was not printed by this command with these arguments
errors.fix: Start again without --cursor

errors.meaning: A finding argument is out of range (round or seq below 1)
errors.fix: Pass round and seq of at least 1

errors.meaning: No committed finding has this change, round and seq
errors.fix: List the change's findings: canon finding list --change <CHANGE_ID>

errors.meaning: A rejected or deferred disposition needs --reason
errors.fix: Repeat the command with --reason <TEXT>

errors.meaning: Only a fixed disposition may carry --resolution-rev
errors.fix: Drop --resolution-rev, or use --disposition fixed

errors.meaning: The finding is staged, not committed yet
errors.fix: Promote it first: canon gate promote --kind finding

errors.meaning: A --input value differs from the same argument on the command line
errors.fix: Give the argument once, or give the same value in both

errors.meaning: --input cannot be read or framed, or a document fails the command's fragment schema
errors.fix: Fix the key `field` points at; canon schema <COMMAND> --json shows the input schema

errors.meaning: --input exceeds input.maxBytes, or a batch exceeds input.maxItems
errors.fix: Split the input into smaller invocations

errors.meaning: A bug in canon
errors.fix: Report it with the command line and the message

errors.meaning: The repository has no commit to resolve a revision against
errors.fix: Commit once, then repeat

errors.meaning: The repository uses a layout this canon no longer reads
errors.fix: Run canon migrate --json to preview the migration

errors.meaning: What the plan digest covers changed since the preview
errors.fix: Run the command without --commit to preview again, then commit with the new digest

errors.meaning: The record was staged but promoting it failed
errors.fix: Run canon gate promote --kind finding --json

errors.meaning: The repository directory cannot be read
errors.fix: Check --repo and its permissions

errors.meaning: A purge stopped after deleting some records
errors.fix: Preview again; the plan lists what remains

errors.meaning: A command word is not in the tree
errors.fix: Pick one of `expected`; canon schema --json lists every command

errors.meaning: --as names a role canon does not know
errors.fix: Use one of planner, implementer, reviewer, orchestrator

errors.meaning: The check examined nothing, so it cannot say the state is clean
errors.fix: See meta.coverage for what was missing

errors.meaning: The command line does not parse or does not satisfy the command's requirements
errors.fix: Run canon schema <COMMAND> --json for the command's arguments

errors.meaning: Writing the record failed after the write began
errors.fix: Run canon status --json to see what was written, then repeat
